name: HybridX Streak
description: Keep a weekly training streak. Every activity your watch records counts automatically, and every week you hit your target is a step up a mountain.

configFields.label: Weekly target
configFields.description: How many sessions make a week. Changes apply from next week.

configFields.label: Week starts on
configFields.description: 0 is Sunday, 1 Monday, and so on to 6 for Saturday. Changing it closes the current week early.

configFields.label: What counts
configFields.description: 0 counts every session. Or just one kind: 1 run, 2 ride, 3 walk, 4 strength, 5 workout, 6 hybrid, 7 row, 8 other.

configFields.label: Shortest session
configFields.description: Recorded sessions shorter than this don't count, so an accidental start never does. 0 counts everything.

configFields.label: One per day
configFields.description: Count at most one session a day towards the target.
